mainline/xihuamen#2.zh: 王进回到家中，闷闷不已，对娘说知此事。
mainline/xihuamen#2.t: Wang Jin came home in low spirits and told his mother what had happened.

mainline/xihuamen#3.t: Mother and son held each other and wept.

mainline/xihuamen#4.zh: 我儿，三十六着，走为上着。只恐没处走。
mainline/xihuamen#4.t: My son, of the thirty-six strategies, running away is the best. I only fear there is nowhere to run.

mainline/xihuamen#5.zh: 母亲说得是。儿子寻思，也是这般计较。只有延安府老种经略相公镇守边庭，他手下军官多有曾到京师，爱儿子使枪棒的极多，何不逃去投奔他们？那里是用人去处，足可安身立命。
mainline/xihuamen#5.t: You're right, Mother. I've been thinking the same. Old General Zhong, the Military Commissioner of Yan'an, guards the frontier, and many of his officers have been to the capital and are fond of my spear and staff work. Why not flee and join them? They need men there; we could make a life for ourselves.

mainline/xihuamen#6.zh: 我儿，和你要私走，只恐门前两个牌军，是殿帅府拨来伏侍你的，他若得知，须走不脱。
mainline/xihuamen#6.t: My son, if we slip away, I fear the two guardsmen at the gate, sent by the Marshal's Office to wait on you. If they find out, we'll never get away.

mainline/xihuamen#7.zh: 不妨。母亲放心，儿子自有道理措置他。
mainline/xihuamen#7.t: No matter. Don't worry, Mother. I know how to deal with them.

mainline/xihuamen#8.zh: 你先吃了些晚饭，我使你一处去干事。
mainline/xihuamen#8.t: Have some supper first. I have an errand for you.

mainline/xihuamen#9.t: Where are you sending me, Instructor?

mainline/xihuamen#10.zh: 我因前日病患，许下酸枣门外岳庙里香愿，明日早要去烧炷头香。你可今晚先去分付庙祝，教他来日早开些庙门，等我来烧炷头香，就要三牲献刘李王。你就庙里歇了等我。
mainline/xihuamen#10.t: When I was sick I vowed an offering at the Temple of Mount Tai outside Suanzao Gate, and tomorrow morning I mean to burn the first incense. Go tonight and tell the temple keeper to open the gates early tomorrow and wait for me; I want the three sacrificial meats offered to Lord Liu and Lord Li. Spend the night at the temple and wait for me there.

mainline/xihuamen#13.zh: 当夜子母二人收拾了行李衣服、细软银两，做一担儿打挟了；又装两个料袋袱驼，拴在马上。等到五更，天色未明——
mainline/xihuamen#13.t: That night mother and son packed their bundles of clothes, valuables and silver into a shoulder load, and filled two saddlebags to tie on the horse. They waited until the fifth watch, before daybreak...

mainline/xihuamen#14.zh: 你与我将这些银两去岳庙里，和张牌买个三牲煮熟，在那里等候。我买些纸烛，随后便来。
mainline/xihuamen#14.t: Take this silver to the temple, and with Zhang Pai buy the three sacrificial meats and have them cooked. Wait for me there. I'll buy paper offerings and candles and follow you.

mainline/xihuamen#16.zh: 娘，上马罢。趁天色未明，出西华门去。
mainline/xihuamen#16.t: Mount up, Mother. While it's still dark, we go out by the West Flower Gate.

mainline/xihuamen#17.zh: 王进扶娘上了马，家中粗重都弃了，锁上前后门，挑了担儿，跟在马后，趁五更天色未明，乘势出了西华门，取路望延安府来。
mainline/xihuamen#17.t: Wang Jin helped his mother onto the horse, left all the heavy things behind, locked the front and back doors, shouldered his load and walked behind the horse. Before dawn, in the fifth watch, they slipped out of the West Flower Gate and took the road to Yan'an.

mainline/xihuamen#18.zh: 次日 · 酸枣门外岳庙
mainline/xihuamen#18.t: Next Day · Temple of Mount Tai outside Suanzao Gate

mainline/xihuamen#19.zh: 且说两个牌军买了福物煮熟，在庙里等到巳牌，也不见来；回到王教头家看时，门上锁着，两头无路。直等到黄昏，不见回来，只得去殿帅府首告：「王教头弃家在逃，子母不知去向。」
mainline/xihuamen#19.t: Meanwhile the two guardsmen bought the offerings, cooked them and waited at the temple until mid-morning, but no one came. Back at Instructor Wang's house they found the doors locked and no one about. They waited till dusk, and when no one returned they had no choice but to report to the Marshal's Office: "Instructor Wang has abandoned his home and fled; mother and son are nowhere to be found."

mainline/xihuamen#20.zh: 高太尉见告了，大怒道：「贼配军在逃，看那厮待走那里去！」随即押下文书，行开诸州各府，捉拿逃军王进。
mainline/xihuamen#20.t: Marshal Gao flew into a rage: "A convict on the run! Let's see where the wretch thinks he can go!" He issued warrants to every prefecture and county to arrest the deserter Wang Jin.

mainline/xihuamen#21.zh: 且说王教头母子二人，自离了东京，在路饥餐渴饮，夜住晓行，一月有余。高俅差来的追兵，却已在后面紧紧赶来……
mainline/xihuamen#21.t: Instructor Wang and his mother, having left the Eastern Capital, ate when hungry and drank when thirsty, resting by night and walking by day, for more than a month. But the men Gao Qiu sent after them were already close behind...

mainline/xihuamen#22.zh: 王进母子私离东京，投延安府去了。
mainline/xihuamen#22.t: Wang Jin and his mother have slipped away from the Eastern Capital, bound for Yan'an.
